## objective
G2: iOS 26 Liquid Glass restyle: glass tokens, floating glass tab bar, floating top buttons, mic control, camera pills, large titles
- discovery: Run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` first. No new dependencies. The design contract is .orchestrator/design/STYLE-GLASS.md (read it fully; it overrides STYLE.md where they differ) and the G-*.dc.html boards in .orchestrator/design/canvas/ if present (open G-Foundations and two screens; they are static HTML with inline styles that you can lift values from). Keep the colour tokens and fonts from src/styles/tokens.css; this task adds a glass layer and restyles the shell, it does not change any behaviour or test semantics.

1. src/styles/tokens.css: add the glass tokens from STYLE-GLASS.md as CSS variables (--glass-light-bg, --glass-light-border, --glass-light-shadow, --glass-dark-*, --glass-clear-*, --glass-blur: 24px, --glass-tint-moss, --radius-capsule, --tabbar-h: 64px, --tabbar-gap: 16px) and utility classes: .glass-light, .glass-dark, .glass-clear (background + backdrop-filter + -webkit-backdrop-filter + border + box-shadow + position relative + overflow hidden), .glass-specular::before (the top highlight gradient, pointer-events none), .tint-moss. Add `@media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce)` fallbacks exactly as the sheet lists them. Add the paper and night radial glows as .bg-paper and .bg-night.
2. src/components/TabBar.tsx (new) replacing the nav markup in src/App.tsx: floating capsule (height 64, radius 32, 16px side gutters, 16px above the bottom safe area, `padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom)` handling), five tabs look/listen/review/diary/settings (if the Screen union does not yet contain "listen" because task R has not merged, render the four existing tabs and leave a one-line TODO; do not add the screen yourself), stroke icons 24px 1.75, labels 11/600, the selected tab in a moss-tinted capsule 56x48. Dark variant on look (camera), roleplay and listen screens, light elsewhere. Hidden on roleplay live and listen live states (full-screen), still rendered on idle states. Every screen's scroll container gets 96px bottom padding.
3. src/components/GlassButton.tsx (new): a 44px circular glass button (light/dark variant, aria-label required) used for back/close/settings actions at the top corners; replace any solid top bars in Look, Scene, Roleplay, Corrections, Review, Diary, Settings with large titles in content (34/41 Bricolage) plus floating buttons where the screen had a bar action.
4. Mic control (Roleplay, ReviewCard, Listen if present): 88px circle, glass-clear ring with specular and the four state dots from the sheet (idle white 60 %, listening moss with rings, speaking sun, thinking white 30 %). Keep the existing pointer handlers, labels and test ids so src/screens/*.test.tsx stay green.
5. Camera (Look/Scene): object label pills become glass-clear pills with a moss dot; a 35 % dim gradient at top 120px and bottom 160px behind the floating controls; the task pill is glass-regular-dark.
6. Sheets (ObjectSheet, Settings groups): paper at 96 % with blur 20px, radius 28, grab handle 36x5; content stays paper cards. Never put glass on cards, lists or text (HIG rule quoted in the sheet).
7. Type: adopt the scale from the sheet (large title 34/41, title 28/34, headline 17/22, body 17/22, footnote 13/18) via the existing --text-* variables; adjust only variables and the few places that hard-code sizes.
8. index.html: `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">` so safe-area insets work in the installed app and the iOS shell.
Tests: src/components/TabBar.test.tsx (renders the tabs, marks the current screen selected, calls go on tap, hidden in live states, dark variant on night screens), src/components/GlassButton.test.tsx (aria-label required, variant class), src/styles/tokens.test.ts (`// @vitest-environment node`: tokens.css contains the glass variables, the reduced-transparency media query and the three glass classes). All existing tests must stay green; where a test asserts old nav markup, update the assertion to the new TabBar, nothing else.

- src/components/TabBar.test.tsx, src/components/GlassButton.test.tsx and src/styles/tokens.test.ts pass: five (or four, if listen is absent) tabs with selected state and navigation, hidden in live states, dark variant on night screens; glass variables, classes and the prefers-reduced-transparency fallback present
- All previously passing screen tests still pass; the only test edits are nav-markup assertions updated to the TabBar
- No behaviour change: src/lib/**, src/voice/**, src/srs/**, api/** are untouched (git diff --name-only against the base must not list them)
- index.html viewport has viewport-fit=cover; tokens.css keeps every existing variable name

# Alltag, iOS 26 Liquid Glass layer (v2 of STYLE.md; everything not listed here stays as in STYLE.md)

Source rules (Apple HIG, Materials, read 2026-10-10): Liquid Glass is "a distinct functional layer for controls and navigation elements, like tab bars and sidebars, that floats above the content layer". Regular variant "blurs and adjusts the luminosity of background content to maintain legibility"; clear variant is "highly translucent", only "for components that float above media backgrounds such as photos and videos", with "a dark dimming layer of 35% opacity" if the media is bright. "Don't use Liquid Glass in the content layer." "Use Liquid Glass effects sparingly." "Help ensure legibility by using vibrant colors on top of materials." Mobbin references for the floating tab bar: Waymo, IMDb, Shop (pill tab bars floating over content); camera overlays: Halide Mark III, Grok (glass menus/sheets over the viewfinder).

## Where glass lives (and where it does not)
- GLASS: the floating tab bar, floating circular top buttons (back, close, settings), the mic control ring, floating pills over the camera (object labels, task pill), the bottom glass bar on camera/roleplay/listen, toasts.
- NOT GLASS: cards, lists, review cards, settings rows, diary entries, text. Those use paper (#F6F5F2) and card (#FFFFFF) exactly as in STYLE.md. Never glass on glass: a glass pill never sits on a glass bar; the label row on camera is a set of separate pills, not pills on a bar.

## Materials (inline styles; backdrop-filter is allowed in .dc.html)
- glass-regular-light (over paper or light content):
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.58); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(160%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: same;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.75); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9) inset, 0 8px 32px rgba(21,24,28,0.12), 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(21,24,28,0.08);
  text: ink #15181C, secondary #5B6069.
- glass-regular-dark (over night #0D0F12, the camera when dimmed, photos):
  background: rgba(20,22,26,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(160%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.18) inset, 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
  text: #FFFFFF, secondary rgba(255,255,255,0.72).
- glass-clear (over the live camera or a photo; needs a 35 % dim layer behind it when the image is bright):
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(140%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.38); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.45) inset, 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); text #FFFFFF.
- specular: every glass element gets a top highlight as a pseudo layer: an absolutely positioned div, inset 0, border-radius inherit, background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.42) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 42%), pointer-events none. On dark glass use 0.22.
- tint (selected tab, active state): layer moss at 18 % (rgba(15,110,86,0.18)) on light glass; moss at 28 % on dark glass; the icon and label become moss #0F6E56 (light) or #9BD7C3 (dark).
- reduce-transparency fallback (mention once on the Foundations board): glass-regular-light -> card #FFFFFF with line #E3E1DB; glass-regular-dark -> #1A1D22; glass-clear -> rgba(20,22,26,0.72).

## Shapes (concentric corners)
- Capsules for the tab bar (height 64, radius 32), pills (height 36, radius 18), buttons (height 52, radius 26), mic control (diameter 88, circle).
- Floating circular buttons: 44 x 44, radius 22.
- Sheets: radius 28 at the top; glass only on the sheet's top "handle zone" is NOT used; sheets are paper at 96 % with blur 20px (regular material), grab handle 36 x 5 #C9C7C1.
- Concentric rule: inner radius = outer radius minus padding. A 16px-padded 28px card holds 12px-radius children.
- Floating tab bar: 16px side gutters, 16px above the bottom safe padding (so y = 844 - 34 - 16 - 64 = 730 top edge). Content scrolls under it; the last content item gets 96px bottom padding.

## Tab bar (5 tabs after listen mode): look, listen, review, diary, settings
Icons stroke 1.75, 24px; label 11px/600 Instrument Sans under the icon; selected tab = tinted capsule 56 x 48 radius 24 behind icon + label. On night screens (camera, roleplay, listen live) the bar is glass-regular-dark; elsewhere glass-regular-light.

## Top controls
No solid top bar. One or two floating circular glass buttons (back/close at left, action at right) at y = 54 + 8, x = 16 / 390 - 16 - 44. Titles live in the content (large title 34/41 700 Bricolage), not in a bar.

## Controls
- Primary button: moss filled capsule, white text 17/600 (not glass).
- Secondary / floating action: glass capsule (light or dark per background), ink/white text 17/600.
- Mic control: 88px circle, glass-clear ring 2px border rgba(255,255,255,0.6) + specular, centre dot 24px: idle = white 60 %, listening = moss with a 1px moss ring at 64px (pulse implied by a second faint ring at 104px, 20 % opacity), speaking = sun #F2C94C, thinking = white 30 %.
- Object label pills on camera: glass-clear pills (height 36) with French label 15/600 white and a 6px moss dot; on tap they become glass-regular-dark.
- Chips/filters: paper chips as before; selected = moss soft #DDEFE7 with moss text (not glass).

## Type scale (iOS-like metrics, keep the two brand faces)
large title 34/41 700 Bricolage; title 28/34 700 Bricolage; headline 17/22 600 Instrument; body 17/22 400 Instrument; callout 16/21; footnote 13/18; caption 12/16. French learner text keeps the display face at 22/28 500.

## Backgrounds
Paper screens: #F6F5F2 with a very soft moss radial glow top-left (radial-gradient(60% 40% at 10% 0%, rgba(15,110,86,0.08), transparent)) so glass has something to refract. Night screens: #0D0F12 with a faint radial at 50% 100% rgba(242,201,76,0.06) (sun) for the same reason. Camera: the photo placeholder from FORMAT.md plus a 35 % dim layer only where clear glass sits (top 120px and bottom 160px gradients).
